description: Health tips | ప్రతి ఒక్కరికీ ఏదో ఒకసారి సాధారణంగా ఎదురయ్యే కడుపుబ్బరం, అజీర్తి, మలబద్ధకం లాంటి సమస్యలకు వంటింట్లోనే చక్కని పరిష్కారం దొరుకుతుంది. నిత్యం వంటల్లో ఉపయోగించే జీలకర్ర (Jeera), మెంతులు, పసుపు (Turmeric Powder), యాలకులు, లవంగం (Clove), అల్లం (Ginjer), వెల్లుల్లి (Garlic) లాంటి వాటిని వివిధ రకాల అనారోగ్య సమస్యల పరిష్కారానికి వినియోగిస్తుంటాం. అందులో అజీర్తి సమస్యకు ‌మెంతులు చక్కని పరిష్కారం చూపుతాయి.

title: Allied Blenders Q2 Results: Profit rises 9.7% to Rs 69 crore, revenue up 6.8%
description: Allied Blenders and Distillers reported a net profit increase of 9.7% in the September quarter of FY27. The company's revenue from operations rose by 6.8% compared to the previous fiscal year. Total expenses for the quarter were recorded at Rs 1,946.3 crore, reflecting a 6.51% rise. Total income, including other income, increased by 6.74% at Rs 2,089.46 crore in Q2 FY27. The shares of ABD closed at Rs 692.

title: Indus Towers Q2 Results: Net profit slips 2.5% to Rs 1,793 crore
description: Indus Towers reported a 2.5% decline in consolidated net profit for the second quarter ended September 30. The company experienced a 4% increase in consolidated revenue, while EBITDA saw a slight rise of 0.4%. Tower and co-location bases grew by 5.6% and 5.9%, respectively, contributing to improved performance. Strong customer demand and cash generation were highlighted as key growth drivers.

title: SAIL Q2 Results: Net profit surges four-fold to Rs 1750 crore on higher revenue
description: Steel Authority of India Ltd announced a significant increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. The company reported a profit of Rs 1,750.47 crore, a substantial rise from the previous year. Revenue from operations also saw growth, reaching Rs 31,997.55 crore compared to Rs 26,704.17 crore last year. Total expenses rose modestly to Rs 29,913.65 crore from Rs 26,113.64 crore.

title: United Breweries Q2 Results: Profit jumps nearly 3 times to Rs 134 crore on volume growth, premiumisation
description: United Breweries Ltd experienced a nearly three-fold increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations rose by 23.7 percent year-on-year, reflecting strong market performance.
